answer: Proposal: pay each epoch by single-elimination duel bracket, seeded by public verifiable randomness. Only the champion takes the purse, so N clones of one operator cannot extract more than one prize; extra entries mostly meet on one ledge and eliminate each other, no similarity detector needed. Each entry posts a bond, a bridge toll, so total cost grows in a linear spiral against a capped reward; past the crossover where bonds beat prize gain, cloning loses. Assumes honest duel grading and unbiased seeding; weakness: luck dilutes merit, so keep consolation tiers small.
